item.title: SANCTUARY SEEKS ADVISORY COUNCIL APPLICANTS: 18 SEATS OPEN TO ADVISE KEYS WATERS
item.description: NOAA’s Office of National Marine Sanctuaries is recruiting for 18 openings on the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary Advisory Council. The council ensures public participation in the management of the sanctuary by acting as a liaison between the Florida Keys community and sanctuary leadership.
